reviews.title: Good amount of memory for the price.  colorful and vibrant
reviews.comment:
Wanted to double the ram in my computer, while having nice RGB lighting.
This ram set did exactly what i wanted. Doubled my ram, and connected fine with my MSI lighting software.
No issues installing, worked immediately, but there is some tinkering required to get it to use third party lighting, but nothing super complicated.
the lighting is very vibrant.
The ram size profile is larger than most ram due to the lighting, but shouldn't be an issue if you have at least a mid tower.
Quality is solid, and I have had zero issues with the ram since i installed it, and it's been a few years.
Good about of memory for the price.
reviews.author: Josh

reviews.title: —a true beauty-meets-beast combo that delivers both aesthetic flex and performance firepower
reviews.comment:
This 2x16GB kit hits the sweet spot for modern gaming, multitasking, and content creation. 3600MHz with CL18 latency is right where most Ryzen and Intel 12th/13th-gen CPUs love to hang out—snappy enough to reduce bottlenecks, and stable even under load.
You get dynamic, multi-zone RGB lighting, which syncs beautifully via Corsair iCUE—seriously, the lighting diffusion on this kit is chef’s kiss. Whether you’re rocking a windowed case or just want your internals to match your vibe, this memory brings the glow-up.

reviews.title: Stable, Fast RAM for DDR4 Systems
reviews.comment:
Purchased to replace G.Skill RAM that for some reason would not run in dual channel on the ASUS ROG Strix B550-F Gaming WiFi II motherboard with a Ryzen 5950x. Purchased the 32 Gig kit of DDR4-3600 it overclocked to 4000 easily, stable in memtest and AIDA64, without having to overvolt and mess with timings.
The RAM is easy to Install and just go into the BIOS and enable XPM or D.O.C.P in the BIOS to get the rated speed. From this set and other Corsair RAM kits I have seen they make the RAM compatible with most systems.
The RGB is nice, I love that if you are using any of the Corsair iCue fans, AIO coolers, Keyboards and mice you can set the lighting in the iCue software. you can also download profiles, and this guy Alex has tons of them on his site, you can find link in Corsairs community.
Well worth the money for the product you are getting. I do recommend the Corsair VENGEANCE RGB PRO series DDR4 memory.
reviews.author: Chris Lally
